chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a matter, but he refused and withheld, then said: 'If We were to give you everything you want, it would be evil for you, and the one with this matter would be seized by the neck.'

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The Wilayah of Allah was kept secret by Him to Jibraeel (peace be upon him), and Jibraeel kept it secret to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and Muhammad kept it secret to Ali (peace be upon him), and Ali kept it secret to whoever Allah willed. Then you broadcast it. Who is the one who withheld even a single word he heard?'

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'In the wisdom of the progeny of Dawud (peace be upon him), it is befitting for the Muslim to be master of himself, focused on his affairs, and knowing the people of his time. So fear Allah and do not broadcast our hadith. If it were not for Allah defending His friends and exacting retribution for His friends from their enemies...'

...have you not seen what Allah did with the progeny of Barmak, and what Allah exacted for Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)? And the Banu Al-Ash'ath were upon great danger, so Allah defended them through their Wilayah for Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

And you are in Iraq, seeing the deeds of these Pharaohs, and what Allah has granted them respite. So upon you is Taqwa of Allah, and let not the worldly life deceive you, nor be deceived by the one who has been granted respite, for it is as if the Matter (of the Qaim) has arrived to you.

key_terms.الْأَمْر: The Matter (referring to the rise of the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of concealing knowledge and the Wilayah of the Imams according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) elucidates the wisdom of *kitman* (concealment) by contrasting the Prophet's silence with the companions' broadcasting of knowledge, citing the Banu Al-Ash'ath's deliverance from danger through their Wilayah of Imam Al-Hasan as a precedent. He warns the people of Iraq about the tyrants (*al-fara'ina*) and the imminent arrival of the divine command, emphasizing that divine protection for the faithful often operates through hidden mechanisms rather than immediate public manifestation.
